# Grid Builder — llms.txt

## About
A free nine-box choose-your-path tool from C2R Marketing. Pick a box, get the straight answer: free tips, the $147 AI Visibility Audit, books, and tools. No signup to browse; email capture is optional.

## The four grids
- Churches — what AI says about your church: https://c2r-marketing.github.io/grid-builder/grids/churches/
- Dentists — what AI says about your practice: https://c2r-marketing.github.io/grid-builder/grids/dentists/
- Realtors — what AI says about your listings: https://c2r-marketing.github.io/grid-builder/grids/realtors/
- NMV readers — the New Messianic Version Bible: https://c2r-marketing.github.io/grid-builder/grids/nmv/

## The builder
Build your own nine-box grid, free, in the browser — suggestions, live preview, export standalone HTML: https://c2r-marketing.github.io/grid-builder/builder.html
Click tracking dashboard: https://c2r-marketing.github.io/grid-builder/dashboard.html
